comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
R13 Biology Folklore discovery. It will become available with Chapter 3: Cetus and clues to it can be picked up by buying a drink or meal in the taverns of Seville and Lisbon.

Guide:

1 Sagres - Talk to Prince Henrique Prince x3
2 Cabo Verde - Talk to Barkeep x3
3 Benguela - Talk to Port Official x2
4 Africa Southwest Coast - Talk to Gil ("Northeast from the MAP" Pointed Boulder)

Discovery complete. The name of this discovery? Sorry. I'm not spoiling the surprise this time. Cheers.

Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/QuestDB/action/QuestShow?id=6315

comments.author: RvZ
comments.body:
Correct English name for this discovery: Mokele-mbembe

Folklore Quest name: Folklore Regarding a Giant Creature in Africa
Information acquisition city: Seville / Lisbon / Tunis
Information obtaining method: Order food/drinks from Barkeep / Rest House Master
Skill requirement: r13 Biology
Culture Area of Destination: West Africa
